questions.q: In Surah al-Hadid (57:20), who does the Qur'an call "kuffar"?
questions.explain: Kufr means to cover. A farmer covers the seed with soil.
questions.source: The Mirror, Ch.1 (57:20; Arabic via quran/verse.py excerpt); One Word 01; reflection what-does-kufr-really-mean

questions.q: God sent Musa and Harun to Pharaoh. How were they told to speak to him?
questions.explain: "Speak to him with gentle words" (20:44). Even to Pharaoh.
questions.source: The Mirror, Ch.4 p.37–38 (20:44); One Word 02

questions.q: Surah ar-Ra'd (13:40) says the Prophet's duty was only to…
questions.explain: "Your duty is only to deliver the message, and it is for Us to call them to account."
questions.source: The Mirror, Ch.2 p.16 (13:40); One Word 04

questions.q: 4:135 tells you to stand for justice even if it is against…
questions.explain: "…even if it is against yourselves, your parents or your closest relatives."
questions.source: The Mirror, Ch.3 p.29–30 (4:135); One Word 09

questions.q: In My Prayer, "Allahu Akbar" means Allah is ___ than everything that fills your heart.
questions.explain: Not only "great": greater than the fear, the desire and the sin you think is too big.
questions.source: My Prayer, Ch.4 p.31–32; Track B 01

bonus.q: Which surah does NOT begin with Bismillah?
bonus.source: General knowledge, checked: every surah's text opens with the basmala except Surah 9 (Tanzil Uthmani text). Ties to Track B 02 Bismillah (27 Nov).
